no_candidate_reason: No new candidate showed improved worst-case IL relative to the preexisting independently verified EXP-042 baseline; dense-grid and independent MNA were not run on newly proposed circuits.

benchmark.independent_verification: EXP-042 prior evidence, not new EXP-066 validation

limitations: 8 of 24 screened finalists were optimized; this is not comprehensive enumeration of all numeric configurations.
Finite 5/9/31-point grids do not prove global six-band H2/H3 compliance or continuous frequency limits.
Dense 28x7001, independent coupled-L branch-current MNA, and power-balance checks were not performed on new EXP-066 candidates.
Serialized optimization outputs lost fine-stage SLSQP status object due to an overwritten JSON key; source fixed after the recorded run without retroactive claims.
No physical Q(f), SRF, EM, PCB trace/parasitic tolerance or Phase 3 assessment.
RF-F003 formal specification and Phase3 authorization are unchanged.
